component.name: SideNav
component.description: Sticky vertical navigation rail anchored to the right column of the desktop grid. Renders an anchor link per item plus the shared ThemeToggle. Hidden below 768px in favour of MobileNav.

useCases: in-page section jumping on long scrollable pages
consistent right-rail navigation across desktop views

commonPatterns.name: section anchors
commonPatterns.description: Each item id matches a section id on the page.

commonPatterns.name: paired with MobileNav
commonPatterns.description: Pass the same `items` array to both so desktop and mobile stay in sync.

antiPatterns.reason: Links are constructed as `#${id}` and assume in-page targets.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use a regular anchor outside this component for external destinations.

antiPatterns.reason: Layout grid reserves a 90px column on the right; changing position breaks the two-column grid.
antiPatterns.alternative: Adjust the grid in Layout/pages, keep SideNav structural CSS intact.

parentConstraints: expects to live in the right column of the two-column page grid

accessibility.keyboardSupport: Standard tab order across links and the theme toggle

aiHints.context: Reuse for any desktop page that needs in-page navigation. Always pair with MobileNav passing the same items.
